method: Manual read-only complete relevant function inspection; no source copy or native compilation/execution.
conclusions: Window SaveFocus retains current Window; EndSaveFocus restores only a non-disposed retained Window.
MenuBarWindow ChangeHighlightItem saves focus only on initial activation and clears on deactivation; allow-restore and default-to-document are separate flags.
MenuBarWindow GetFocus activates without popup; LoseFocus deactivates with restoration disabled.
MenuBarWindow PopupClosed forwards saved focus restoration with frame-focus gating and document fallback disabled.
Floating ImplEndPopupMode restores previous focus only while holding child-path focus; PopupEnd forwards root close through MenuBar::ClosePopup into PopupClosed.
MenuFloatingWindow EndExecute first stops popup execution/cleanup then calls ImplSelect, including child-command cleanup at root.
DOM connected external element maps to valid saved Window; browser no-owner document fallback and frame/global native flags remain separate unverified contracts.
